_comment: Pinned HTTP test target for the Playwright/Electron suite. THIS FILE IS THE SINGLE
SOURCE OF TRUTH: the harness provisions the container itself, so no workflow file
restates the image reference. A second copy of the digest anywhere in the repo is a
To move the target: `docker manifest inspect --verbose <image>` and copy the
`Descriptor.digest` value here, then re-run `npm run test:e2e` to confirm every
endpoint the fixtures use still behaves the same.
`containerPort` MUST match the port the image actually listens on — check it with
builds of httpbin bind different ports (this image binds 80; some rebuilds bind
8080), and getting it wrong makes every health check time out.
The image publishes linux/amd64 only — there is no arm64 variant. CI runs on amd64
runners; on arm64 hardware the container runs emulated.
